name: How can I prepare my deck for professional maintenance services?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my deck for professional maintenance services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before professional maintenance, you should clear your deck of all furniture, planters, grills, and other personal items. Sweep off loose debris like leaves and dirt. Ensure access to water and electricity for the crew. Disclose any known problem areas or previous repairs to the team. This preparation helps our Frasheski Construction team work efficiently and ensures thorough coverage during cleaning, staining, or repair processes, minimizing delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all furniture and debris from your deck, ensure access to utilities, and inform the crew of any problem areas to help prepare for professional maintenance.
